verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for a commerce platform, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of automation version history, review, or rollback. The closest items are quarterly API versioning (shopify-docs-x1) and dev-store testing environments (shopify-docs-x2), which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
